summary: Variable licence fee under New Telecom Policy 1999; classification as revenue vs capital expenditure; Section 37 vs Section 35ABB of Income Tax Act 1961; licence fee linked to annual gross revenue; migration from 1994 regime to 1999 policy; 15% provisional share; TRAI recommendation mechanism; one-time entry fee vs recurring fee; 'establish maintain operate' context; annual payment character despite 20-year licence term; precedent reliance on Bharti Cellular; Revenue's arguments rejected; deduction under Section 37 upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment confirming Tribunal decision upheld; variable licence fee held revenue expenditure deductible under Section 37.
